test.name: Spec 0010 spike: START_SUSPENDED, SIGCONT resume, SIGKILL discard

expected: a child spawned with POSIX_SPAWN_START_SUSPENDED runs no code until SIGCONT, also when the SIGCONT comes from a new daemon after the spawning daemon died, and SIGKILL plus waitpid discards a child that never ran (spec 0010 AC-2, AC-9, Adapter macOS row Tertahan dan lanjut)
actual: Right after posix_spawn the child has pbi_status SSTOP (4), kinfo p_stat SSTOP, ri_user_time 0 (still 0 after 400 ms), wrote no argv-serve.json and does not listen. kill(SIGCONT) resumes it: /ready answers 200, pbi_status becomes SRUN (2), user time > 0, and the start time is unchanged by the suspension. Discard: SIGKILL on a suspended child gives NOTE_EXIT with status signaled(9) and waitpid reaps signaled(9); user time was 0, no argv file and empty spools, so it never ran; the lock it inherited is Free afterwards. Daemon death while suspended: a helper 'daemon' spawned a suspended child and exited without SIGCONT; the child stayed SSTOP with ppid 1, no pending signal (kinfo p_siglist 0, so no SIGHUP from orphaning, because SETSID puts it in another session), user time 0, still holding the lock; a SIGCONT from this non-parent process resumed it and it served /ready 200.
